data.title: Lens vs Sporting CP Predictions & Betting Tips - Champions League
data.content:
## Predicted Lineups & Team News

Lens (3-4-2-1) Robin Risser; Jonathan Gradit, Kyllian Antonio, Samson Baidoo; Rubén Aguilar, Michaël Cuisance, Yacine Titraoui, Matthieu Udol; Florian Thauvin, Thorgan Hazard; Franjo Ivanović

Centre-back Maik Nawrocki and Abdallah Sima are injured for this one. Matthieu Udol is suspended for the next Ligue 1 clash and is likely to start. [...] Sporting CP (4-2-3-1) Rui Silva; Iván Fresneda, Zeno Debast, Gonçalo Inácio, Maxi Araújo; Sergi Altimira, Issa Doumbia; Geny Catamo, Rodrigo Zalazar, Nestory Irankunda; Luis Suárez

Nuno Santos is close to returning from injury. Expect Zeno Debast to replace Eduardo Quaresma in central defence.

Maxi Araújo, Rodrigo Zalazar and Luis Suárez should all come back into the starting side in France.

## Verdict [...] Share

Matthew Marshall 12 Oct 2026

Share this article

 Lens are incredibly hard to beat at home
 Sporting haven’t tasted defeat this season
 I am expecting a close clash to end in a draw

Lens

Florian Thauvin provided 2 assists in Lens' 2-1 win against Lyon (Getty)

Lens had the best home record in Ligue 1 last season and Sporting are yet to lose in the current campaign. Everything points to a close encounter in France, both teams likely to be content with a point.
